info.title: API.SH: Snapchat
info.description: The Snapchat API from API.SH: public Snapchat data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
What Snapchat shows logged-out visitors in a country. type=stories: the Discover feed of popular public creator stories and shows, each with its snaps. type=spotlight: the trending Spotlight videos with views, shares, comments, creator and sound.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/snapchat-discover

get.description:
A Snapchat lens page: lens id and uuid, name, creator (name, username, link), official flag, the creator's search tags, preview image and video, icon, Snapcode image, unlock link and update time; the Spotlight snaps made with the lens (link, creator, thumbnail, date, duration, caption, views and shares where shown) and the page's "more lenses" shelf with the same lens fields.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/snapchat-lens

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A snapchat.com/lens/<id> link or a lens unlock link (snapchat.com/unlock/?uuid=...), or the 32-character id in `id`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Lens id (32 hex characters; `unlock_url` uuid in /snapchat/v1/search lenses).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

What snapchat.com/explore shows for a query: Spotlight videos (media URL, views, shares, comments, creator), lenses, topics with snap counts, public profiles, shows, places, show episodes and matching personal accounts (`users`), plus a summary of each section. One page: Snapchat shows logged-out visitors no further results. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/snapchat-search

get.description:
The public story a Snapchat profile has up right now: every snap with its type, media URL, preview and post time, plus the profile's saved highlights. `has_story` is false when nothing is posted at the moment.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/snapchat-stories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Snapchat show or publisher channel page (snapchat.com/p/...): channel title, description, subscribers, images, seasons, the episode list (title, thumbnail, season, episode, publish date, link) and the selected episode with every snap and its media URL. Pass an episode link or `story` to pick an episode; otherwise the channel's featured one is returned.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/snapchat-story-public

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A snapchat.com/p/<id> link (optionally with /<storyId>), or the id alone.

parameters.name: story
parameters.description: Episode (story) id to return in full.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
